race.title: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Handicap
race.verdict: A strong-looking race for the grade with BASED taken to double his career tally with the outside stall hopefully not a hindrance for one who is often dropped in. Honey Dale seeks a quick-fire hat-trick and will doubtless be popular, with Tam Lin perhaps the pick of 4 live chances for Mick Appleby. BASED (IRE) HONEY DALE (IRE) TAM LIN (IRE)
